import json, openpyxl, collections
m=json.load(open('inputs/manifest.json'))
paths={x['name']:x['path'] for x in m}
for name in ['materials.xlsx','balances.xlsx','selling_prices.xlsx']:
    wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(paths[name], data_only=True)
    print('FILE',name,wb.sheetnames)
    for ws in wb.worksheets:
        print(' SHEET',ws.title,'rows',ws.max_row,'cols',ws.max_column)
        hdr=[ws.cell(1,c).value for c in range(1,ws.max_column+1)]
        print('  HDR',hdr)
        for r in range(2,min(5,ws.max_row)+1):
            vals=[ws.cell(r,c).value for c in range(1,ws.max_column+1)]
            print('  ROW',r,[(type(v).__name__,repr(v)) for v in vals])
# join coverage and grouping
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(paths['materials.xlsx'],data_only=True); ws=wb['Material']
mats=[ws.cell(r,1).value for r in range(2,ws.max_row+1)]
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(paths['selling_prices.xlsx'],data_only=True); ws=wb['Price']
prices=[ws.cell(r,1).value for r in range(2,ws.max_row+1)]
print('materials',mats,'prices',prices,'missing_prices',set(map(str,mats))-set(map(str,prices)))
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(paths['balances.xlsx'],data_only=True); ws=wb['Stock']
cnt=collections.Counter((str(ws.cell(r,1).value),str(ws.cell(r,2).value)) for r in range(2,ws.max_row+1))
print('stock_rows',ws.max_row-1,'material_wh_counts',dict(cnt))
print('stock_missing_materials',set(k[0] for k in cnt)-set(map(str,mats)))
